facts.text: The CU Tuition Guarantee covers 100% of tuition for Pell-eligible first-time Kentucky freshmen who have at least a 2.0 high school GPA.

sources.title: CU Tuition Guarantee | Campbellsville University
sources.quote: The CU Tuition Guarantee provides 100% tuition coverage for first-time, full-time students from Kentucky who are Pell Grant eligible and have a minimum cumulative high school GPA of 2.0.
